thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: auth-validation error spike detected (Okta token introspect) — 5xx rate rising to ~10% from baseline 0.3% at 1978765400. Paging primary on-call.

emma: saw multiple customer reports about unable to log into console (500s). Correlating with auth-proxy logs showing 502/503 from okta-api.example.com.

ryan: checking traces — calls to Okta /idp/v2/introspect are returning 502 and sometimes signature-mismatch responses (alg mismatch) around 1978765421. Latency also climbed before errors.

priya: support queue confirms admin users most affected. API keys validated via local cache still okay. Looks like realtime introspect endpoints are failing.

devops-bot: Created incident INC-1982 and started incident bridge.

ryan: short-term mitigation: enable "offline-signature-verify" mode in auth-proxy which uses JWKS cache + rejects only if signature fails, not when Okta returns 5xx. Patch available in branch offline-fallback-1982.

emma: any risk trusting cached JWKS? How stale is our cache?

priya: current JWKS TTL is 300s. We can extend to 3600s temporarily. We'll also enable fallback only for interactive console login routes, keep API validation strict.

ryan: rolling canary (5%) with offline-fallback + JWKS TTL=3600. kubectl apply -f k8s/auth-proxy-canary.yaml --record.

devops-bot: Deploy started auth-proxy/canary pod/auth-proxy-canary-7b9d (1978765460).

emma: canary traffic shows 0 errors on canary; global still at ~9%.

ryan: widen to 40% for next 3 minutes, then 100% if stable.

devops-bot: Widening canary to 40% (1978765490).

priya: pushing to 100% now. Watch auth-verif metric and login success rate.

devops-bot: Canary -> production rollout complete (1978765530). auth-proxy now using offline-signature-verify for console routes.

emma: errors fell to ~0.8% within 90s. Latency normalized.

okta-agent: Okta status: partial disruption in token introspect API in us-east-1, investigating. Support case #OKT-4321 opened.

priya: saved failing request ids: rid_b9f2, rid_b9f8, rid_b9fe (1978765422). Uploading traces to /var/spool/incidents/1982/traces.tar.gz and attaching to OKT-4321.

support-bot: Drafting customer-facing update: "We experienced a third-party identity provider degradation affecting console logins for some users. We implemented a fallback verification mode to restore access. No user data exposure." Scheduling for immediate publish.

emma: note: Observability vendor (trace-collect) had partial ingestion delays which caused some gaps in end-to-end traces between 1978765400-1978765600. We retained local spans for the critical flows.

ryan: follow-ups: 1) revert offline-fallback to config default once Okta confirms service healthy, 2) implement exponential backoff and jitter for introspect calls, 3) increase JWKS TTL with safe guard to still refresh keys periodically.

priya: I opened ENG-3456 "JWKS refresh and fallback policy" and assigned to eng-auth.

support-bot: Public status update posted at 1978765700.

emma: handoff — I'm primary for next 2 hours, then ryan will take over. Keeping channel open for Okta RCA.

okta-agent: added note to OKT-4321: engineering investigating elevated error rates in intropsect endpoint; will post RCA when available.

priya: final customer impact estimate: ~15% of interactive console login attempts failed between 1978765400-1978765700 (~5 minute window) for impacted region; remediation restored >99% success after fallback.

emma: incident state: mitigated; lowering severity to S3 at 1978765880. Postmortem assigned to emma and ryan.

devops-bot: Incident ticket INC-1982 updated with links: /archive/incidents/1978765432/, runbook excerpt: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/idp-deps.

priya: closing active page. Will upload postmortem draft in 24h. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
